context: Re-drive result payload and database serialization with query/fragment sentinels, an embedded password sentinel, an ordinary URL, and a username-only URL. Resolve or supersede the conflicting #1480 implementation rather than stacking competing regexes. Implement component-aware filtering with explicit preservation tests for ordinary URLs and username-only identity. Do not parse arbitrary query strings into a broad redaction of every parameter.
description: Complete platform-options URI credential filtering beyond the open/conflicting #1480 branch. Embedded userinfo is now the intended baseline, but query and fragment parameters such as password, access_token, and sslpassword still leak verbatim in result payloads and ResultDatabase metadata on the candidate branch. Preserve ordinary URLs and username-only identity URLs rather than replacing a non-secret username with a generic mask. This is one concern: precise credential filtering for URI components. This is the corrected successor of platform-options-scrub-uri-credential-params-v1; its stored rung was repaired during adversarial plan review.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not assume the open #1480 PR is sufficient because its userinfo examples pass.
anti_patterns.instead: Use query, fragment, userinfo, and ordinary-URL behavior cases at both export consumers.
anti_patterns.why: Direct payload/database probes still leak query credentials and over-redact username-only URLs.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not redact every URL query parameter.
anti_patterns.instead: Filter credential-named parameters while preserving ordinary values.
anti_patterns.why: Downstream analysis and connection routing may depend on non-secret parameters.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not use a matcher-only grep rung.
anti_patterns.instead: Assert sentinel absence and preservation on returned serialized payloads.
anti_patterns.why: The security property is the serialized output, not the presence of a regex constant.

preserves.behavior: Existing embedded userinfo redaction and structural platform option filtering.
Ordinary URLs, paths, hosts, ports, and non-secret query parameters.
Username-only URI identity when no password/token is present.

verifications.command: uv run --all-extras -- python -c 'import json; from benchbox.core.results.platform_options import sanitize_platform_options; values={"query":"https://example.invalid/export?access_token=URI_QUERY_GATE&x=1","dsn":"postgresql://u:URI_USERINFO_GATE@example.invalid/db?sslpassword=URI_SSL_GATE","username_only":"https://public-user@example.invalid/export","ordinary":"https://example.invalid/export?x=1"}; out=json.dumps(sanitize_platform_options(values)); assert all(x not in out for x in ("URI_QUERY_GATE","URI_USERINFO_GATE","URI_SSL_GATE")) and "public-user" in out and "x=1" in out, out'
verifications.description: Unfixed-tree gate: credential query parameters must be absent while username-only and ordinary URLs remain intact; current develop fails at least one assertion.
verifications.expected: FAIL on unfixed develop: URI query/userinfo credential sentinels leak or username-only precision fails; exits 1 before the component-aware fix and 0 after it.

verifications.command: uv run --all-extras -- python -c 'from benchbox.core.results.platform_options import sanitize_platform_options; o=sanitize_platform_options({"endpoint":"https://example.invalid/export","path":"/warehouse/data","region":"us-east-1"}); assert o=={"endpoint":"https://example.invalid/export","path":"/warehouse/data","region":"us-east-1"}, o'
verifications.description: Regression guard: non-credential URL values remain unchanged by the sanitizer.
verifications.expected: PASS on current develop and after the change: ordinary URL and path values are preserved.

work_units.evidence: Gate fails on develop: query access_token leaks URI_QUERY_GATE; username_only over-redacted to ****@; fragment access_token also leaks. dsn fully key-redacted so userinfo/ssl there hidden by key path. Userinfo-with-password already redacts to ****@.
work_units.summary: Re-drive URI userinfo/query/fragment cases on current develop and inspect #1480 merge state.

work_units.evidence: Component-aware URI scrub: userinfo redacts only when colon (password) present; query/fragment credential params (access_token, sslpassword, ...) masked via is_secret_option_key; ordinary params and username-only preserved. Both verification gates pass.
work_units.summary: Implement component-aware query and fragment credential filtering with username precision.

work_units.evidence: Added username-only + query/fragment sentinel tests; 68 unit tests pass; both verification rungs pass.
work_units.summary: Add result/database serialization regression tests and run option-filter checks.
